exercises.instructionUz: Suratlarni nomlash uchun ro'yxatdan so'z tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
DO'KON NOMLARI.

  ⚠ Ingliz tilida ko'p do'kon nomi
  EGALIK ShAKLIDA: 'a butcher'S',
  'a baker'S', 'a chemist'S'.

  ⚠ Bu - qisqartma: 'a butcher's SHOP'
  ('qassobning do'koni'). 'shop' so'zi
  tushirib qoldiriladi, apostrof qoladi.

  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'at the doctor's'
  (shifokorda), 'at my aunt's'
  (xolamnikida).


RO'YXATDAGI 20 DO'KON:

  a lace shop        - to'r do'koni
  a confectioner's   - shirinlik do'koni
  a bookstall        - kitob rastasi
  a bookshop         - kitob do'koni
  a butcher's        - qassob do'koni
  a bakery           - novvoyxona
  a post office      - pochta
  a newsagent's      - gazeta do'koni
  a greengrocer's    - sabzavot do'koni
  a chemist's        - dorixona
  a travel agent's   - sayohat agentligi
  a supermarket      - supermarket
  an antique shop    - antikvariat
  a boutique         - butik (kiyim)
  a jeweller's       - zargarlik do'koni
  a department store - univermag
  a flower stall     - gul rastasi
  a florist's        - gul do'koni
  a hair & beauty salon - sartaroshxona
  a designer fashion house - moda uyi


⚠ 'A SHOP' va 'A STALL' FARQI:

  a shop  - BINO ichidagi do'kon
  a stall - ko'chadagi RASTA

  ⚠ Shuning uchun 'a bookshop' va
  'a bookstall' - IKKI BOShQA narsa.
  ⚠ 'a flower stall' - ko'chadagi gul
  rastasi; 'a florist's' - do'kon.


⚠ 'A CHEMIST'S' va 'A PHARMACY':

  Britaniyada 'a chemist's',
  AQShda 'a drugstore' yoki
  'a pharmacy'.


⚠ 'A GREENGROCER'S':

  'green' (yashil) + 'grocer' (oziq-ovqat
  sotuvchisi) = meva-sabzavot do'koni.
  ⚠ 'a grocer's' - umuman oziq-ovqat
  do'koni.


⚠ 'A CONFECTIONER'S':

  'confectionery' = shirinlik.
  ⚠ Shokolad, konfet, tort sotiladi.


⚠ 'A BAKERY' - ISTISNO:

  Bu YAGONA nom bo'lib, egalik shaklida
  emas. ⚠ Lekin "a baker's" ham to'g'ri
  va bir xil ma'noda ishlatiladi.

tasks.whyUz:

taqinchoqlar.

⚠ 'a jewel' (javohir) → 'a jeweller' (zargar)
→ "a jeweller's" (zargarlik do'koni).
⚠ AQShda 'a jeweler's' (bitta 'l').

⚠ 'antique' /ænˈtiːk/ deb o'qiladi - fransuzcha

tasks.promptUz: Oq to'rli dasturxon, ko'ylak va salfetkalar
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ D suratida oq to'rli dasturxon, ko'ylak,
salfetkalar.

⚠ 'lace' = to'r, ilma-ilma mato.

⚠ E suratida ustma-ust terilgan shokolad
konfetlar.

⚠ 'confectionery' = shirinlik mahsulotlari.

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ F suratida banan, olma, uzum, piyoz.

⚠ 'green' + 'grocer' = meva-sabzavot sotuvchisi.

⚠ G suratida KO'ChADAGI kitob rastalari.

⚠ 'a stall' = rasta (ko'chada);
'a shop' = do'kon (bino ichida).
Shuning uchun 'bookSHOP' emas, 'bookSTALL'.

  'You can buy apples at a greengrocer's.'

  ⚠ Qolip: You can buy + NARSA + AT +
     a + DO'KON.

  ⚠ Do'kon oldidan 'AT' predlogi
  ('in' emas): 'AT a greengrocer's',
  'AT the post office'.


⚠ BA'ZI BUYUMLARNI IKKI JOYDAN
OLISh MUMKIN:

  a book → a bookshop yoki a bookstall
  a leather jacket → a boutique yoki
     a designer fashion house
  lilies → a florist's yoki a flower
     stall
  a bottle of perfume → a chemist's
     yoki a department store

  ⚠ Bunday hollarda ikkalasi ham
  to'g'ri javob.


⚠ 'A DEPARTMENT STORE' - HAMMASI:

  Univermagda deyarli hamma narsa bor:
  kiyim, mebel, texnika, atir.
  ⚠ 21-betdagi matn Harrods univermagi
  haqida.


⚠ IDISh-O'LChOV SO'ZLARI:

  a PAIR OF trousers - bir juft shim
  a PACKET OF painkillers - bir quti dori
  a BOTTLE OF perfume - bir shisha atir
  a BOUQUET OF roses - bir dasta atirgul
  a LOAF OF bread - bir bo'lak non

  ⚠ 'trousers' - HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA,
  shuning uchun 'a pair of' kerak.
  ⚠ 'bread' - SANALMAYDIGAN, shuning
  uchun 'a loaf of'.


⚠ MATERIAL SIFATLARI:

  leather - charm
  woollen - jundan
  gold    - oltin
  lace    - to'rdan

  ⚠ Ot material sifatida ishlatilganda
  artikl olmaydi: 'a LEATHER jacket'.

exercises.explanationUz:
XUShMUOMALA ILTIMOS VA JAVOB.

KITOBDAGI JADVAL:

  REQUESTS (iltimoslar):
     Can I have ... , please?
     Could I have ... , please?
     Have you got any ...?
     I'd like ... , please.

  ANSWERS (javoblar):
     Yes, of course.
     Here you are.
     I'm afraid we haven't got any left.


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: Can I have some apples, please?
  SB: I'm afraid we haven't got any left.


⚠ 'CAN' va 'COULD' FARQI:

  Can I have ...?   - oddiy, samimiy
  Could I have ...? - XUShMUOMALAROQ

  ⚠ 'could' bu yerda O'TGAN ZAMON
  EMAS - u iltimosni YUMShATADI.

  ⚠ Yana muloyimroq: 'May I have ...?'


⚠ 'I'D LIKE' = 'I WOULD LIKE':

  = ... olsam deb edim.
  ⚠ 'I want' dan ancha MULOYIM.
  ⚠ Do'konda va restoranda 'I want'
  deyish QO'POL eshitiladi.


⚠ "I'M AFRAID ...":

  = afsuski, ...
  ⚠ So'zma-so'z 'qo'rqaman' EMAS!
  Bu - yomon xabarni yumshatuvchi
  ibora.


⚠ 'ANY' - SO'ROQ VA INKORDA:

  'Have you got ANY apples?' (so'roq)
  "We haven't got ANY left." (inkor)
  'I've got SOME apples.' (tasdiq)

  ⚠ 'some' - tasdiqda;
  'any' - so'roq va inkorda.
  ⚠ Bu 6-unitning grammatika mavzusi.


⚠ 'LEFT' = QOLGAN:

  "We haven't got any LEFT."
  = bizda qolmagan.
  ⚠ 'to leave' (qoldirmoq) fe'lining
  3-shakli.


⚠ 'HERE YOU ARE':

  = mana, oling.
  ⚠ 10-betdagi 27-mashqda ham bor edi.

exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAMMA IBORA MAQOLADA BOR.

  ⚠ Bu yana COLLOCATION mashqi: qaysi
  sifat/ot qaysi ot bilan yuradi.


⚠ 'A(N)' BELGISI - MUHIM YoRDAM:

  1, 4-bandlarda 'a(n)' bor → ot
  BIRLIKDA va SANALADIGAN.
  Qolganlarida artikl yo'q → ko'plik
  yoki sanalmaydigan.

  ⚠ 'a(n)' yozilgani - keyingi so'z
  unli bilan boshlanishi ham mumkin
  degani.


⚠ OT + OT BIRIKMASI:

  Ko'p javob SIFAT emas, OT:
     a SHOPPER'S paradise
     ANTIQUE lovers
     a DEPARTMENT store
     BANK accounts
     FASHION houses
     AUTUMN collections

  ⚠ Birinchi ot SIFAT vazifasini
  bajaradi va HAR DOIM BIRLIKDA
  qoladi: 'bank accountS' ('banks
  accounts' XATO).


⚠ 'HIGH QUALITY':

  = yuqori sifat.
  ⚠ 'good quality' ham to'g'ri.
  ⚠ 'quality' SANALMAYDIGAN.


⚠ 'RARE':

  = noyob, kam uchraydigan.
  ⚠ 'a rare book' = noyob kitob.
  ⚠ Yana 'rarely' = kamdan-kam
  (14-betdagi 12-mashqda).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the synonyms from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan sinonimlarni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
SINONIMLAR - BIR XIL MA'NOLI SO'ZLAR.

  ⚠ Chap tomonda ODDIY so'z, o'ng
  tomonda MAQOLADAGI so'z.

  ⚠ Bu usul lug'atni ikki barobar
  kengaytiradi: bir ma'no - ikki so'z.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  fashionable = trendy
     (modabop)
  a great variety of = a wide range of
     (katta tur, keng tanlov)
  wonderful = fantastic
     (ajoyib)
  an opportunity = a chance
     (imkoniyat)
  a lot of = plenty of
     (ko'p)


⚠ 'TRENDY':

  = zamonaviy, modabop.
  ⚠ 'a trend' (moda yo'nalishi) so'zidan.
  ⚠ 'trendy' - so'zlashuv uslubi;
  'fashionable' - neytral.


⚠ 'PLENTY OF' va 'A LOT OF':

  Ikkalasi ham 'ko'p' degani va
  sanaladigan hamda sanalmaydigan
  otlar bilan ishlatiladi.

  ⚠ 'plenty of' biroz ko'proq ta'kid
  beradi: 'yetarlicha ko'p'.
  ⚠ 'of' ni TUShIRMANG.


⚠ 'A CHANCE' va 'AN OPPORTUNITY':

  a chance - imkoniyat; tasodif
  an opportunity - imkoniyat (rasmiyroq)

  ⚠ Matnda: "Don't miss the CHANCE."
  ⚠ 'by chance' = tasodifan.


⚠ 'A RANGE' va 'A VARIETY':

  a wide range of - keng tanlov
  a great variety of - katta tur

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham do'kon va mahsulot
  haqida ishlatiladi - reklama tili.

BESh FE'L - HAMMASI MAQOLADA BOR.

  buy   - sotib olmoq
  line  - qator bo'lib tizilmoq
  suit  - mos kelmoq
  miss  - boy bermoq; sog'inmoq
  offer - taklif etmoq


⚠ 'TO LINE' - G'ALATI FE'L:

  'a line' (ot) = chiziq, qator
  'to line' (fe'l) = qator bo'lib
     tizilmoq, chetini qoplamoq

  ⚠ Matnda: 'the bookstalls LINING the
  banks of the River Seine' = daryo
  qirg'og'i bo'ylab TIZILGAN kitob
  rastalari.


⚠ 'TO SUIT' - UCh MA'NO:

  1) mos kelmoq (did, hamyon):
     'something to SUIT everyone's taste'
  2) yarashmoq (kiyim):
     'That dress suits you.'
  3) 'a suit' (ot) = kostyum

  ⚠ 'to suit' va 'to fit' FARQI:
     suit - yarashadi (rang, uslub)
     fit  - to'g'ri keladi (o'lcham)


⚠ 'TO MISS' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) boy bermoq, o'tkazib yubormoq:
     "Don't MISS the chance."
     'I missed the bus.'
  2) sog'inmoq:
     'I miss my family.'


⚠ 'TO OFFER':

  = taklif etmoq, taqdim etmoq.
  ⚠ Matnda: 'Galleries Lafayette ...
  OFFERS a great variety'.
  ⚠ 'an offer' (ot) = taklif -
  8-betdagi modul rejasida ham bor edi.


⚠ 'DURING THE BIG SALES':

  'during' = davomida.
  ⚠ 'during' + OT ('during the sales');
  'while' + GAP ('while I was shopping').

exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR - HAMMASI MAQOLADA BOR.


⚠ KO'ChA NOMI BILAN:

  ON Bonaparte Street (AQSh)
  IN Bonaparte Street (Britaniya)

  ⚠ Matnda 'ON' ishlatilgan.
  ⚠ Manzil bilan esa 'AT':
  'AT 25 Bonaparte Street'.


⚠ 'ON THE BOOKSTALLS':

  ⚠ Rasta - USTIDA narsa turadigan
  yuza, shuning uchun 'ON'.
  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'on the shelf',
  'on the table'.


⚠ 'THE BANKS OF THE RIVER':

  ⚠ 'of' - egalik/tegishlilik.
  ⚠ 'a bank' bu yerda = daryo qirg'og'i
  (BANK muassasasi emas!).

  ⚠ Matnda ikkala ma'no ham bor:
  'the BANKS of the River Seine'
     (qirg'oq)
  'big BANK accounts' (muassasa)


⚠ VAQT ORALIG'I:

  FROM eight IN the morning
  TILL seven IN the evening

  ⚠ 'from ... till/to ...' - juftlik:
  biri bo'lsa ikkinchisi ham ShART.
  ⚠ 'IN the morning/afternoon/evening'
  ⚠ ISTISNO: 'AT night'.

⚠ Rasta - USTIDA narsa turadigan yuza →
'ON'.
⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'on the shelf', 'on the table'.

⚠ 'of' - tegishlilik.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the shapes (a - d) to the adjectives.
exercises.instructionUz: Shakllarni (a - d) sifatlar bilan moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
SHAKL SIFATLARI.

  a - KVADRAT (to'rt teng tomon)
  b - TO'RTBURChAK (uzun, cho'ziq)
  c - UChBURChAK
  d - DOIRA


⚠ OT VA SIFAT JUFTLIKLARI:

  a square    → square
     (ot va sifat BIR XIL)
  a rectangle → rectangular
  a triangle  → triangular
  a circle    → round / circular

  ⚠ 'round' - oddiy nutqda;
  'circular' - rasmiy/texnik.


⚠ YANA ShAKLLAR:

  oval      - oval
  a diamond - romb
  a star    - yulduz
  a heart   - yurak
  a cube    - kub
  a sphere  - shar
  a cylinder - silindr


⚠ 'SQUARE' - KO'P MA'NOLI:

  1) kvadrat (shakl)
  2) maydon: 'Trafalgar Square'
  3) kvadrat (matematikada):
     'four squared' = to'rtning kvadrati


⚠ 'A TRIANGLE':

  'tri-' (uch) + 'angle' (burchak)
  = uch burchakli shakl.

  ⚠ 'tri-' old qo'shimchasi: tricycle
  (uch g'ildirakli velosiped),
  triple (uch karra).

exercises.instructionUz: 1 - 3 tavsiflarga mos buyumlarni toping, so'ng qolgan buyumlarni tasvirlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
SURATDAGI BUYUMLAR:

  a briefcase   - portfel
  a coat hanger - kiyim ilgichi
  a CD          - disk
  a rucksack    - ryukzak
  an alarm clock - budilnik
  a ball        - to'p
  a wallet      - hamyon
  a camera      - fotoapparat
  a fridge      - muzlatgich


TAVSIFLARNING TUZILIShI - TO'RT QISM:

  1) O'LChAM + ShAKL + RANG:
     'It's a small triangular brown
      object.'
  2) MATERIAL:
     "It's made of wood and metal."
  3) VAZIFA:
     'We hang clothes on it.'

  ⚠ Bu - buyumni nomini bilmasdan
  tasvirlashning universal usuli.
  Chet tilda so'z esdan chiqsa, aynan
  shunday tushuntiriladi.


⚠ 'TO BE MADE OF' va 'TO BE MADE FROM':

  made OF - material KO'RINIB turadi
     'made of wood', 'made of leather'
  made FROM - material O'ZGARGAN
     'Paper is made from wood.'

  ⚠ Tavsiflarda 'made OF'.


⚠ 'AN OBJECT':

  = buyum, narsa.
  ⚠ Urg'u: OBject (ot) - obJECT (fe'l,
  'e'tiroz bildirmoq').


⚠ QOLGAN BUYUMLARNI TASVIRLASh:

  briefcase: 'It's a large rectangular
     black object. It's made of leather.
     We carry papers in it.'
  CD: 'It's a small round silver object.
     It's made of plastic. We listen to
     music on it.'
  rucksack: 'It's a large orange object.
     It's made of nylon. We carry things
     in it on our back.'
  alarm clock: 'It's a small square white

tasks.en: Exotic Shopping in Paris

tasks.en: [1] Paris, the capital of France, is a shopper's paradise, with plenty of large department stores as well as thousands of delightful smaller shops.
tasks.uz: [1] Fransiya poytaxti Parij - xaridorning jannati: bu yerda ko'plab katta univermaglar va minglab yoqimli kichik do'konlar bor.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'the capital of France' - IZOh, verguller
bilan ajratiladi.
⚠ "a shopper's paradise" - egalik apostrofi.
⚠ 'plenty of' = ko'p (8-mashqda sinonimi).
⚠ 'as well as' = shuningdek, ... dan tashqari.
⚠ 'delightful' = yoqimli.

tasks.en: [2] Antique lovers can find fantastic furniture in the small antique shops on Bonaparte and Jacob Streets, and collectors can find rare books on the bookstalls lining the banks of the River Seine.
tasks.uz: [2] Antikvariat ixlosmandlari Bonapart va Jakob ko'chalaridagi kichik antikvariat do'konlaridan ajoyib mebel topa oladi, kolleksionerlar esa Sena daryosi qirg'og'i bo'ylab tizilgan kitob rastalaridan noyob kitoblar topadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a lover' bu yerda = ixlosmand ('sevishgan'
emas).
⚠ 'furniture' - SANALMAYDIGAN ot ('furnitures'
XATO).
⚠ 'to line' = qator bo'lib tizilmoq (9-mashqda).
⚠ 'the banks OF the river' - daryo qirg'og'i.

tasks.en: [2] There are also some great department stores which sell everything from perfume to furniture.
tasks.uz: [2] Yana atirdan mebelgacha hamma narsani sotadigan zo'r univermaglar bor.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'which' - nisbiy olmosh (12-unit mavzusi).
⚠ 'everything FROM ... TO ...' - keng qamrovni
ko'rsatuvchi qolip.

tasks.en: [2] Galleries Lafayette, Paris' largest department store on Boulevard Haussmann, offers a great variety of high quality woollen skirts, leather jackets and designer clothes.
tasks.uz: [2] Bulvar Osmandagi Parijning eng katta univermagi Galeri Lafayet yuqori sifatli jun yubkalar, charm kurtkalar va dizayner kiyimlarining katta turini taklif etadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ "Paris'" - 's' bilan tugagan otga egalik:
faqat APOSTROF.
⚠ 'to offer' = taklif etmoq (9-mashqda).
⚠ 'a great variety of' = katta tur (8-mashqda
sinonimi).

tasks.en: [2] The Marais is a group of little streets with some of the trendiest boutiques. There you can buy fashionable clothes, shoes and jewellery.
tasks.uz: [2] Mare - eng modabop butiklar joylashgan kichik ko'chalar guruhi. U yerdan modabop kiyim, poyabzal va taqinchoq sotib olish mumkin.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'trendiest' - 'trendy' ning eng yuqori
darajasi (undosh + y → -iest).
⚠ 'jewellery' - SANALMAYDIGAN ot; Britaniya
imlosi (AQShda 'jewelry').

tasks.en: [2] For shoppers with big bank accounts, there is a wide range of jewellers' and designer fashion houses along the Rue de Rivoli, such as Cartier, Chanel, Nina Ricci and Christian Dior.
tasks.uz: [2] Katta bank hisobiga ega xaridorlar uchun Rivoli ko'chasi bo'ylab Cartier, Chanel, Nina Ricci va Christian Dior kabi zargarlik do'konlari va moda uylarining keng turi bor.
tasks.note:

⚠ 'a wide range of' = keng tur (8-mashqda).
⚠ 'such as' = ... kabi (misol keltirish).
⚠ "jewellers'" - KO'PLIKDA egalik: apostrof
-S dan KEYIN.

tasks.en: [3] Shops in Paris are usually open from eight or ten in the morning till about seven in the evening, from Monday to Saturday.
tasks.uz: [3] Parijdagi do'konlar odatda dushanbadan shanbagacha ertalab sakkiz yoki o'ndan kechqurun yettilargacha ochiq.
tasks.note:

(10-mashqda).
⚠ 'IN the morning', 'IN the evening' -
predlog 'in'.
⚠ 'from Monday TO Saturday' - kunlar oralig'i.

tasks.en: [3] The big sales come after Christmas and before the autumn collections.

exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLANING TO'LIQ MATNI VA TARJIMASI
bandlarda berilgan.


⚠ HARRODS NIMA:

  Londondagi eng mashhur univermag,
  Knightsbridge tumanida.
  1849-yilda kichik oziq-ovqat do'koni
  sifatida ochilgan.


⚠ SARLAVHA - DO'KON ShIORI:

  'All Things, for All People, Everywhere'
  = Hamma narsa, hamma uchun, hamma joyda.

  ⚠ Bu - 'a motto' (shior). Matnning
  oxirgi qismida shu so'z bor.

  ⚠ Uch qism ham 'ALL' va 'EVERY-'
  bilan - takror ohang beradi.


⚠ MATNNING BESh QISMI (18a javobi):

  a - Location & Management
      (joylashuv va rahbariyat)
  b - History of the Store
      (do'kon tarixi)
  c - Departments & Services
      (bo'limlar va xizmatlar)
  d - The Sales (chegirmalar)
  e - Recommendation (tavsiya)


⚠ RAQAMLAR - DIQQAT BILAN:

  1849  - ochilgan yil
  1983  - chet elga chiqqan yil
  35,000 - kunlik tashrifchi
  300   - bo'limlar soni
  7     - qavatlar
  4,000 - xodimlar
  8     - eshikbonlar
  19    - bar va restoranlar
  300,000 - chegirmaning birinchi kunidagi
            xaridorlar

  ⚠ 17 va 20-mashqlar aynan shu
  raqamlarni tekshiradi.

tasks.en: "All Things, for All People, Everywhere"
tasks.uz: "Hamma narsa, hamma uchun, hamma joyda"

tasks.en: [a] "Enter a Different World", it says on the doormat, and this is what you do when you visit Harrods in Knightsbridge, London.
tasks.uz: [a] "Boshqa dunyoga qadam qo'ying", - deb yozilgan poyandozda, va Londonning Knightsbridge tumanidagi Harrodsga borganingizda aynan shunday bo'ladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a doormat' = eshik oldidagi poyandoz.
⚠ 'Enter' - BUYRUQ gapi, predlogsiz:
'enter a world' ('enter INTO' XATO).
⚠ Knightsbridge - 'k' va 'gh' O'QILMAYDI:
/ˈnaɪtsbrɪdʒ/.

tasks.en: [a] Harrods is "the world's most celebrated store", says Chairman Mr Mohamed Al Fayed.
tasks.uz: [a] Harrods - "dunyodagi eng mashhur do'kon", - deydi rais janob Muhammad Al Fayed.
tasks.note:
⚠ "the world's most celebrated" - egalik +
eng yuqori daraja.
⚠ 'celebrated' bu yerda = mashhur (bayram
ma'nosida emas!).
⚠ 'a chairman' = rais, boshqaruv raisi.

tasks.en: [b] In the beginning, though, Harrods was just a small grocer's shop. It was opened in 1849 and run by Charles Henry Harrod.
tasks.uz: [b] Ammo boshida Harrods shunchaki kichik oziq-ovqat do'koni edi. U 1849-yilda ochilgan va Charlz Genri Harrod tomonidan boshqarilgan.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'though' gap o'rtasida = 'ammo', verguller
bilan.
⚠ 'was opened', 'run' - MAJHUL NISBAT.
⚠ 'to run a shop' = do'kon boshqarmoq
(19-mashqda).
⚠ 'run' - noto'g'ri fe'l: run - ran - run.

tasks.en: [b] His son took over and added medicines and perfumes, as well as fruit, flowers, sweets and a van delivery service.
tasks.uz: [b] O'g'li ishni qo'lga oldi va dori hamda atirlarni, shuningdek meva, gul, shirinlik va furgonda yetkazib berish xizmatini qo'shdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to take over' = ishni qo'lga olmoq
(13-betdagi 7-mashqda ham bor edi).
⚠ 'as well as' = shuningdek.
⚠ 'a van' = furgon; 'delivery' = yetkazib berish.

tasks.en: [b] Over the years, Harrods has survived a fire, two World Wars and even two bombings.
tasks.uz: [b] Yillar davomida Harrods yong'in, ikki jahon urushi va hatto ikki portlashdan omon qolgan.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'over the years' = yillar davomida
(19-mashqda).
⚠ 'to survive' = omon qolmoq - predlogsiz!
'survive from' XATO.
⚠ 'has survived' - PRESENT PERFECT.

tasks.en: [b] In 1983, Harrods moved abroad and opened a branch in Japan and later others in Hong Kong, Singapore and Taiwan, as well as airport shops in most major European cities.
tasks.uz: [b] 1983-yilda Harrods chet elga chiqdi va Yaponiyada filial ochdi, keyinroq Gonkong, Singapur va Tayvanda, shuningdek Yevropaning aksar yirik shaharlarida aeroport do'konlarini ochdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'abroad' - PREDLOGSIZ ravish:
'to go abroad' ('to abroad' XATO).
⚠ 'a branch' = filial; shox.
⚠ 'major' = yirik, asosiy.

tasks.en: [c] Today, around 35,000 people visit Harrods every day. It has got 300 departments spread over seven floors and employs over 4,000 staff.
tasks.uz: [c] Bugun Harrodsga har kuni taxminan 35 000 kishi tashrif buyuradi. Unda yetti qavatga yoyilgan 300 bo'lim bor va u 4000 dan ortiq xodim ishlatadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to spread' = yoymoq (spread - spread -
spread, o'zgarmaydi).
⚠ 'to employ' = ishga olmoq.
⚠ 'staff' - JAMOA oti, KO'PLIK ma'nosida:
'4,000 staff' ('staffs' XATO).

tasks.en: [c] It also has eight doormen, known as 'Green Men', as well as its own fire brigade, security personnel, doctors and nurses.
tasks.uz: [c] Yana sakkizta eshikboni bor - ular 'Yashil odamlar' deb ataladi, shuningdek o'z o't o'chirish bo'limi, qo'riqchilari, shifokorlari va hamshiralari bor.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a doorman' → ko'plikda 'doorMEN'.
⚠ 'known as' = ... deb tanilgan.
⚠ 'a fire brigade' = o't o'chirish bo'limi.
⚠ 'personnel' - SANALMAYDIGAN, urg'u OXIRIDA:
person-NEL.

tasks.en: [c] Harrods is the official supplier of certain goods to the Royal Family, and sells everything from clothes to caviar.
tasks.uz: [c] Harrods qirol oilasiga ayrim mahsulotlarning rasmiy yetkazib beruvchisi va kiyimdan ikragacha hamma narsani sotadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a supplier' = yetkazib beruvchi
('to supply' fe'lidan).
⚠ 'goods' = mahsulotlar - HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA.
⚠ 'certain' bu yerda = ayrim, ba'zi.

tasks.en: [c] The Food Halls are still the heart and soul of Harrods. In addition to the nineteen bars and restaurants in the store, there is a bank, a travel agent's, a dry cleaner's and the biggest hair and beauty salon in Europe.
tasks.uz: [c] Oziq-ovqat zallari hamon Harrodsning yuragi va joni. Do'kondagi o'n to'qqizta bar va restorandan tashqari bank, sayohat agentligi, kimyoviy tozalash va Yevropadagi eng katta sartaroshxona bor.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'the heart and soul of' = yuragi va joni
(19-mashqda).
⚠ 'in addition to' = ... dan tashqari.
⚠ "a dry cleaner's" = kimyoviy tozalash -
yana egalik shakli (18-betdagi qoida).

tasks.en: [d] January and July are very busy months for Harrods because they are sale times. Over 300,000 customers visit the store on the first day alone.
tasks.uz: [d] Yanvar va iyul Harrods uchun juda band oylar, chunki bu chegirma vaqti. Faqat birinchi kunning o'zida 300 000 dan ortiq xaridor do'konga keladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'busy months' - 19-mashqda.
⚠ 'alone' bu yerda = faqat, yolg'iz
('on the first day ALONE' = faqat birinchi
kunning o'zida).
⚠ 'a customer' = xaridor, mijoz.

tasks.en: [d] Many people sleep outside the store all night to be first in when the doors open on the first day.
tasks.uz: [d] Ko'p odam birinchi kuni eshiklar ochilganda birinchi bo'lib kirish uchun tun bo'yi do'kon oldida uxlaydi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'outside' - PREDLOGSIZ: 'outside the store'.
⚠ 'to be first in' = birinchi bo'lib kirmoq.
⚠ 'all night' - artiklsiz.

tasks.en: [e] "All things, for all people, everywhere" is the store's motto. The Harrods name means the best of British quality, service and style.
tasks.uz: [e] "Hamma narsa, hamma uchun, hamma joyda" - do'konning shiori. Harrods nomi Britaniya sifati, xizmati va uslubining eng yaxshisini anglatadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a motto' = shior. Italyanchadan kirgan;
ko'pligi 'mottoes' yoki 'mottos'.
⚠ "the store's motto" - egalik apostrofi.
⚠ 'quality' - 19-betdagi 7-mashqda ham bor edi.

tasks.en: [e] All in all, Harrods is a fascinating place to visit.
tasks.uz: [e] Umuman olganda, Harrods - tashrif buyurishga arziydigan maftunkor joy.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'all in all' = umuman olganda - xulosa
iborasi.
⚠ 'fascinating' = maftunkor (7-betdagi Tailand
matnida ham bor edi).
⚠ 'a place TO VISIT' - otdan keyin INFINITIV.

exercises.instructionEn: Order of Adjectives
exercises.instructionUz: Sifatlar tartibi
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI.


1) SIFAT OTNI TASVIRLAYDI:

  'Adjectives describe nouns. They have
   the same form in the singular and
   plural.'

  e.g. a blue dress - two blue dresses

  ⚠ ENG MUHIM FARQ: ingliz sifati
  KO'PLIKDA O'ZGARMAYDI.
  ⚠ 'two blueS dresses' - XATO.


2) IKKI TUR SIFAT:

  OPINION (fikr) adjectives:
     beautiful, great, expensive, nice
     = biz NIMA DEB O'YLAYMIZ

  FACT (haqiqat) adjectives:
     short, long, red, wooden
     = narsa ASLIDA QANDAY

  ⚠ QOIDA: OPINION sifati FACT
  sifatidan OLDIN turadi.

  'She's wearing a BEAUTIFUL RED dress.'
     (opinion) (fact)

  ⚠ 'a red beautiful dress' - XATO.


3) FACT SIFATLARINING TARTIBI:

  size     - small, big, short, long
  weight   - heavy, light
  shape    - triangular, round,
             rectangular, square
  colour   - dark/light blue, yellow,
             pink, cream, red, purple
  material - cotton, leather, silk,
             plastic, woollen, nylon,
             metal, gold, silver, velvet,
             wooden, canvas

  ⚠ KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  "It's a beautiful, long, light blue,
   silk skirt."
     beautiful - OPINION
     long      - SIZE
     light blue - COLOUR
     silk      - MATERIAL


⚠ QISQA ESLATMA (yodlash uchun):

  FIKR → O'LChAM → OG'IRLIK →
  ShAKL → RANG → MATERIAL → OT

  ⚠ O'zbekchada bunday qat'iy tartib
  yo'q - shuning uchun bu qoidani
  ataylab yodlash kerak.


⚠ VERGUL QO'YILADIMI:

  Kitobdagi namunada vergul bor:
  'a beautiful, long, light blue, silk
   skirt'
  ⚠ Vergulsiz ham to'g'ri:
  'a beautiful long light blue silk
   skirt'
  ⚠ Amalda 2-3 tadan ortiq sifat kam
  ishlatiladi.


⚠ MATERIAL SIFATLARI - OTDAN:

  gold, silver, metal, plastic, silk,
  cotton, velvet, canvas - bular OT,
  lekin sifat vazifasida ishlatiladi.

  ⚠ Ba'zilari -EN oladi:
     wood → wooden
     wool → woollen
     gold → golden (ko'chma ma'noda)

  ⚠ 'a gold ring' = oltindan uzuk
  ⚠ 'a golden opportunity' = oltin
     imkoniyat (ko'chma)

exercises.instructionEn: Comparative and superlative forms of adjectives.
exercises.instructionUz: Sifatlarning qiyosiy va eng yuqori darajasi.
exercises.explanationUz:
SIFATNING UCh DARAJASI.

  1) ODDIY (positive):    big
  2) QIYoSIY (comparative): biggER THAN
  3) ENG YUQORI (superlative):
     THE biggEST


QANDAY YaSALADI - UZUNLIGIGA QARAB:

  QISQA SIFATLAR (bir bo'g'inli va
  ba'zi ikki bo'g'inli):
     + -ER / THE + -EST

     short  → shorter  → the shortest
     long   → longer   → the longest
     cheap  → cheaper  → the cheapest

  UZUN SIFATLAR (ikki va undan ko'p
  bo'g'inli):
     MORE + sifat / THE MOST + sifat

     expensive → more expensive →
        the most expensive
     beautiful → more beautiful →
        the most beautiful


⚠ IMLO QOIDALARI (qisqa sifatlar):

  1) 'E' bilan tugasa - faqat -R/-ST:
     large → larger → the largest
     nice  → nicer  → the nicest

  2) QISQA UNLI + BITTA UNDOSh →
     UNDOSh IKKILANADI:
     big → biGGer → the biGGest
     hot → hoTTer → the hoTTest
     thin → thiNNer → the thiNNest

  3) UNDOSh + Y → -IER/-IEST:
     easy → easier → the easiest
     happy → happier → the happiest
     trendy → trendier → the trendiest


⚠ QOIDASIZ ShAKLLAR - YoDLASh ShART:

  good   → better  → the best
  bad    → worse   → the worst
  little → less    → the least
  much/many → more → the most
  far    → further/farther →
           the furthest/farthest

  ⚠ Jadvalda 'good', 'bad', 'little'
  aynan shu qoidasizlar.


⚠ 'THAN' va 'THE':

  QIYoSIYda 'THAN':
     'cheaper THAN the brown skirt'

exercises.instructionEn: Adjectives describe nouns. They have the same form in the singular and plural: a red car - (two) red cars. Adjectives go before nouns: a large box. They can also be used alone after the verb to be and after verbs such as look, smell, sound, feel, taste etc: Mary is tall. You look sad. It smells horrible. There are two kinds of adjectives: opinion adjectives (e.g. beautiful, lovely, great, expensive) which show what a person thinks of somebody or something, and fact adjectives (e.g. short, square, yellow, cotton) which give us factual information (e.g. size, weight, colour, etc).

Sifatlar ikki xil: FIKR sifatlari (beautiful, lovely, great, expensive) - odamning fikrini bildiradi; FAKT sifatlari (short, square, yellow, cotton) - haqiqiy ma'lumot beradi (o'lcham, og'irlik, rang va h.k.).

tasks.en: Form: One-syllable adjectives add -(e)r/-(e)st: large - larger (than) - the largest (of/in); cheap - cheaper - the cheapest. One-syllable adjectives ending in one stressed vowel between two consonants double the last consonant: big - bigger - the biggest. Two-syllable adjectives ending in a consonant + -y drop -y and add -ier/-iest: heavy - heavier - the heaviest. Adjectives of two or more syllables take more/most: careful - more careful - the most careful. Irregular adjectives have their own individual forms. Note: We often make comparisons using than. We use the before the superlative form.
tasks.uz: Shakl: Bir bo'g'inli sifatlar -(e)r/-(e)st oladi: large - larger (than) - the largest (of/in); cheap - cheaper - the cheapest. Ikki undosh orasida bitta urg'uli unli bilan tugaydigan bir bo'g'inli sifatlarda oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi: big - bigger - the biggest. Undosh + -y bilan tugaydigan ikki bo'g'inli sifatlar -y ni tashlab -ier/-iest oladi: heavy - heavier - the heaviest. Ikki va undan ko'p bo'g'inli sifatlar more/most oladi: careful - more careful - the most careful. Noto'g'ri sifatlarning o'z shakllari bor. Eslatma: Qiyoslashda ko'pincha 'than' ishlatiladi. exercises.explanationUz:
/h/ TOVUShI.

  ⚠ Bu unitning talaffuz mavzusi -
  3-betdagi mundarijada 'Pronunciation:
  /h/' deb yozilgan edi.


⚠ /h/ QANDAY AYTILADI:

  Og'izdan YENGIL nafas chiqariladi -
  tomoqdan emas.

  ⚠ O'zbek tilidagi 'h' ga o'xshaydi,
  lekin 'x' ga EMAS.
  ⚠ 'hat' - 'xat' EMAS!


⚠ QAChON /h/ O'QILMAYDI:

  1) 'hour', 'honest', 'honour', 'heir'
     so'zlarida (17-betdagi 27-mashq)

  2) 'he', 'him', 'his', 'her', 'have',
     'has', 'had' so'zlari gap
     O'RTASIDA kelganda - tez nutqda
     'h' yo'qoladi:

     'Who hit her?' → /huː ˈhɪt ə/
        (oxirgi 'her' da 'h' yo'q)
     'I haven't heard from Henry.'
        (bu yerda 'h' O'QILADI, chunki
        so'z URG'ULI)

  ⚠ Bu hodisa 'h-dropping' deb ataladi
  va TEZ nutqning tabiiy qismi.


BETDAGI MAShQLAR:

  1) hat - have - hot - hear
     ⚠ To'rt xil unli, bir xil /h/.

  2) 'Who hit her?'
     ⚠ 'who' da 'h' O'QILMAYDI (/huː/),
     'hit' da O'QILADI, 'her' da tez
     nutqda TUShADI.

  3) "I haven't heard from Henry for
     ages."
     ⚠ Uchta /h/ ketma-ket.
     ⚠ 'for ages' = uzoq vaqtdan beri.

  4) 'Harriet has got a hundred hats.'
     ⚠ To'rtta /h/.

  5) "He hasn't had a holiday for years."
     ⚠ To'rtta /h/.

  6) 'Harry hates hot dogs.'
     ⚠ To'rtta /h/.


⚠ 'FOR AGES' va 'FOR YEARS':

  Ikkalasi ham 'uzoq vaqtdan beri'.
  ⚠ PRESENT PERFECT bilan ishlatiladi -
  bu 7-unitning mavzusi.


⚠ 'WHO' - 'W' O'QILMAYDI:

  'who' /huː/ - 'w' jim, 'h' o'qiladi.
  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'whole', 'whose'.
  ⚠ Lekin 'what', 'when', 'where' da
  'h' jim, 'w' o'qiladi!

exercises.explanationUz:
BRYUSSEL - BELGIYa POYTAXTI.

  Dialogda ikki do'st: A (Alice) va
  L (Lisa). Lisa Bryusselni biladi va
  Alice'ga do'konlarni ko'rsatadi.


⚠ BRYUSSEL NIMASI BILAN MAShHUR:

  • ShOKOLAD (Leonidas - mashhur
    shokolad do'koni)
  • TO'R (lace) - qo'lda to'qilgan
    Bryussel to'ri butun dunyoda
    mashhur
  • ANTIKVARIAT (Sablon tumani)

  ⚠ Betdagi oval rasm ham TO'R
  naqshida ishlangan.


DIALOGDAGI JOYLAR:

  the Sablon District - antikvariat
     tumani
  Dewindt on Lebeaustraat - antikvariat
     do'koni
  Inno Brussels on rue Neuve -
     eng mashhur univermag
  Leonidas on Boterstraat - shokolad
     do'koni
  F. Rubbrecht in the Grand-Place -
     to'r do'koni

  ⚠ 'straat' - gollandcha 'ko'cha';
  'rue' - fransuzcha 'ko'cha'.
  Bryusselda IKKI rasmiy til bor -
  shuning uchun ko'cha nomlari ikki
  xil.


⚠ 'SHOP TILL YOU DROP' - UNIT NOMI:

  Lisa dialogda aynan shu iborani
  ishlatadi: 'you can shop till you
  drop, my dear'.

  ⚠ Kitob unit nomini matn ichida
  QAYTA ishlatadi - bu tasodif emas.


⚠ 'WHERE SHALL WE GO FIRST?':

  'shall' - TAKLIF va MASLAHAT so'rash
  uchun (faqat 'I' va 'we' bilan).
  ⚠ 'Shall we go?' = boraylikmi?
  ⚠ 'Where shall we go?' = qayerga
  boraylik?


⚠ 'YOU MUST VISIT ...':

  'must' bu yerda MAJBURIYaT emas,
  KUChLI TAVSIYa: 'albatta boring'.


⚠ QUESTION TAGS:

  'Brussels is famous for chocolate and
   lace, ISN'T IT?'
  'The shops are open from nine to six,
   AREN'T THEY?'

  ⚠ Bu 15-unitning grammatika mavzusi.
  ⚠ Qoida: gap TASDIQ bo'lsa tag INKOR,
  gap INKOR bo'lsa tag TASDIQ.

exercises.explanationUz:
SARLAVHA TAKLIF QILISh VA QAYD OLISh.


⚠ YAXShI SARLAVHA QANDAY BO'LADI:

  • QISQA (3-5 so'z)
  • matnning ASOSIY fikrini beradi
  • qiziqish uyg'otadi

  ⚠ Ko'pincha SO'Z O'YINI yoki IBORA
  ishlatiladi - unit nomi
  'Shop till you Drop!' ham shunday.


TAKLIF QILISh MUMKIN BO'LGAN
SARLAVHALAR:

  'A Shopper's Paradise'
  'Shopping in the City of Fashion'
  'Paris: Something for Everyone'
  'From Antiques to Designer Clothes'


TO'RT SARLAVHA (b qismi):

  1) name of city - location
  2) best shops - where they are -
     things to buy
  3) opening hours - sales
  4) recommendation

  ⚠ Bu - 6a mashqidagi to'rt xatboshi
  bilan AYNI.

  ⚠ Ya'ni maqolaning tuzilishi
  gapirishning ham rejasi bo'ladi.


⚠ QAYD OLIShDA TO'LIQ GAP YoZMANG:

  ✓ Paris - capital of France
  ✗ 'Paris is the capital of France.'

  ⚠ Qayd qancha qisqa bo'lsa, gapirganda
  shuncha erkin bo'lasiz.

tasks.note:
⚠ Yaxshi sarlavha QISQA bo'ladi va asosiy
fikrni beradi.

⚠ Ikkinchisi matnning oxirgi gapidan olingan:
'something to suit everyone's pocket and taste'.

tasks.en: name of city - location: Paris, the capital of France

tasks.note:

tasks.en: best shops - where they are - things to buy: antique shops on Bonaparte and Jacob Streets (furniture); bookstalls on the banks of the River Seine (rare books); Galleries Lafayette on Boulevard Haussmann (woollen skirts, leather jackets, designer clothes); The Marais (fashionable clothes, shoes, jewellery); Rue de Rivoli (jewellers' and designer fashion houses)

tasks.note:
⚠ Maqolaning 2-xatboshisidan - eng UZUN qism.

⚠ Har do'kon uchun: QAYERDA + NIMA SOTILADI.

tasks.en: opening hours - sales: usually from eight or ten in the morning till about seven in the evening, from Monday to Saturday; big sales after Christmas and before the autumn collections
tasks.uz: ish vaqti - chegirmalar: odatda dushanbadan shanbagacha ertalab sakkiz yoki o'ndan kechqurun yettilargacha; katta chegirmalar Rojdestvodan keyin va kuzgi kolleksiyalardan oldin
tasks.note:
⚠ Maqolaning 3-xatboshisidan.
⚠ 'from ... till ...' juftligini ishlating.

tasks.en: recommendation: Don't miss the chance to go shopping in Paris - there is always something to suit everyone's pocket and taste.
tasks.uz: tavsiya: Parijda xaridga borish imkoniyatini boy bermang - har kimning hamyoni va didiga mos narsa doim topiladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ Maqolaning 4-xatboshisidan.
⚠ Tavsiya odatda BUYRUQ gapi bilan beriladi:
"Don't miss ...", 'You should visit ...'

tasks.en: History of the Store: opened in 1849 by Charles Henry Harrod as a small grocer's shop; his son took over; survived a fire, two World Wars and two bombings; went abroad in 1983
tasks.uz: Do'kon tarixi: 1849-yilda Charlz Genri Harrod tomonidan kichik oziq-ovqat do'koni sifatida ochilgan; o'g'li ishni qo'lga oldi; yong'in, ikki jahon urushi va ikki portlashdan omon qolgan; 1983-yilda chet elga chiqqan
tasks.note:
⚠ Zamon: PAST SIMPLE va PRESENT PERFECT.
⚠ 'has survived' - natijasi hozir ham bor.

tasks.en: Departments & Services: 35,000 visitors a day; 300 departments on seven floors; over 4,000 staff; eight doormen ('Green Men'); own fire brigade, security personnel, doctors and nurses; official supplier to the Royal Family; nineteen bars and restaurants; a bank, a travel agent's, a dry cleaner's, the biggest hair and beauty salon in Europe
tasks.uz: Bo'limlar va xizmatlar: kuniga 35 000 tashrifchi; yetti qavatda 300 bo'lim; 4000 dan ortiq xodim; sakkiz eshikbon ('Yashil odamlar'); o'z o't o'chirish bo'limi, qo'riqchilari, shifokorlari va hamshiralari; qirol oilasiga rasmiy yetkazib beruvchi; o'n to'qqiz bar va restoran; bank, sayohat agentligi, kimyoviy tozalash, Yevropadagi eng katta sartaroshxona
tasks.note:
⚠ Eng UZUN qism - eng ko'p RAQAM shu yerda.
⚠ 17 va 20-mashqlar aynan shu raqamlarni
tekshiradi.

tasks.en: The Sales: January and July; over 300,000 customers on the first day; people sleep outside all night
tasks.uz: Chegirmalar: yanvar va iyul; birinchi kuni 300 000 dan ortiq xaridor; odamlar tun bo'yi tashqarida uxlaydi
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a sale' = chegirma savdosi.
⚠ 19-betdagi Parij matnida ham chegirmalar
haqida edi.

tasks.en: Recommendation: 'All things, for all people, everywhere' - the store's motto; Harrods is a fascinating place to visit.
tasks.uz: Tavsiya: 'Hamma narsa, hamma uchun, hamma joyda' - do'konning shiori; Harrods - tashrif buyurishga arziydigan maftunkor joy.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'all in all' = umuman olganda - xulosani
boshlash iborasi.
⚠ 'a place to visit' - otdan keyin INFINITIV.

qo'llash.

departments.'

YO'QOLGAN BUYUM HAQIDA DIALOG.

  ⚠ Bu - haqiqiy hayotda kerak bo'ladigan
  vaziyat: vokzal, aeroport, mehmonxona.


DIALOGNING TUZILIShI - BESh QADAM:

  1) MUAMMONI AYTISh
     "Excuse me. I've lost my briefcase.
      Has anybody handed it in?"

  2) TAVSIF SO'RASh
     'What does it look like?'

  3) TASVIRLASh
     "It's a black leather briefcase with
      a brown handle."

  4) IChIDAGISINI SO'RASh
     "What's it got in it?"

  5) TOPILISh
     'Is this it?' - 'Oh, yes! Thank you
      very much!'


⚠ 'TO HAND STH IN':

  = topilgan narsani topshirmoq.
  ⚠ 'Has anybody handed it in?' =
  kimdir topshirdimi?

  ⚠ Zarrachali fe'l: to'ldiruvchi
  o'rtada bo'lishi mumkin:
  'handed IT in'.


⚠ "WHAT DOES IT LOOK LIKE?":

  = u qanday ko'rinadi?
  ⚠ 6-betda ODAM haqida edi, bu yerda
  BUYUM haqida - qolip BIR XIL.


⚠ "WHAT'S IT GOT IN IT?":

  = ichida nima bor?
  ⚠ To'liq: 'What has it got in it?'
  ⚠ Britaniya so'zlashuv uslubi.


⚠ 'LOST PROPERTY':

  = yo'qolgan buyumlar.
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN: 'lost properties'
  XATO.
  ⚠ 'the Lost Property Office' -
  vokzallardagi topilma buyumlar bo'limi.
  ⚠ AQShda 'Lost and Found'.


⚠ 'A PURSE' - IKKI MA'NO:

  Britaniyada: ayollar hamyoni
  AQShda: ayollar sumkasi

  ⚠ Dialogda Britaniya ma'nosida.


KO'RSATMALAR (yangi dialog uchun):

  wallet: money, photos, driving licence,
     phonecard
  suitcase: clothes, shoes, camera,
     a bottle of perfume
  rucksack: notebooks, wallet, identity
     card, four books

exercises.explanationUz:
NARX SO'RASh DIALOGI.


⚠ 'HOW MUCH IS ...?' va
'HOW MUCH ARE ...?':

  BIRLIK: 'How much IS this jacket?'
  KO'PLIK: 'How much ARE these boots?'

  ⚠ 'a pair of boots' - EGA 'a pair'
  (BIRLIK), shuning uchun 'How much IS
  this pair of boots?'
  ⚠ Lekin 'These boots? They'RE 60 funt' -
  'boots' ko'plik.

  ⚠ Dialogda IKKALASI ham bor - bu
  ataylab.


⚠ 'DO YOU TAKE CREDIT CARDS?':

  = kredit karta qabul qilasizmi?
  ⚠ 'to take' bu yerda = qabul qilmoq.
  ⚠ Yana: 'Do you accept credit cards?'


⚠ "I'M AFRAID NOT":

  = afsuski, yo'q.
  ⚠ To'liq: "I'm afraid we don't."
  ⚠ 18-betda ham "I'm afraid we haven't
  got any left" bor edi.


⚠ 'TO PAY CASH':

  = naqd pul bilan to'lamoq.
  ⚠ 'cash' - SANALMAYDIGAN.
  ⚠ 'to pay BY credit card' (predlog 'by')
  lekin 'to pay CASH' (predlogsiz) yoki
  'to pay IN cash'.


⚠ "THAT'S OKAY":

  = mayli, hechqisi yo'q.
  ⚠ 10-betdagi 27-mashqda uzr javobida
  ham shu ibora bor edi.


⚠ 'THEN' GAP OXIRIDA:

  "I'll pay cash, THEN."
  = unda naqd to'layman.
  ⚠ 'then' bu yerda 'keyin' emas,
  'unda, u holda' ma'nosida.

exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXATDAGI TO'RT GAP:

  - Could I have the pills in this
    prescription, please?
  - Certainly. What would you like in it?
  - Here you are.
  - Can you deliver it?


QANDAY JOYLAShTIRILADI:

  1-DIALOG (gul do'koni):
     A: I'd like to order a bouquet of
        flowers, please.
     B: CERTAINLY. WHAT WOULD YOU LIKE
        IN IT?
     A: Roses, please, and perhaps some
        lilies. CAN YOU DELIVER IT?
     B: Yes, if it's local.

     ⚠ 'in it' = guldastaning IChIDA
     nima bo'lsin.
     ⚠ 'if it's local' = agar shu
     shaharda bo'lsa - demak
     YETKAZIB BERISh haqida gap ketyapti.

  2-DIALOG (dorixona):
     A: COULD I HAVE THE PILLS IN THIS
        PRESCRIPTION, PLEASE?
     B: Certainly. That will be £5,
        please.
     A: HERE YOU ARE.
     B: Thank you. Remember to take the
        tablets twice a day after meals.

     ⚠ 'a prescription' va 'tablets' -
     DORIXONA belgisi.
     ⚠ 'Here you are' - pul uzatilganda.


⚠ 'CERTAINLY':

  = albatta.
  ⚠ 'Of course' bilan bir xil ma'no,
  lekin RASMIYROQ - xizmat sohasida
  ko'p ishlatiladi.


⚠ 'A PRESCRIPTION':

  = shifokor retsepti.
  ⚠ 'to prescribe' = dori yozib bermoq.
  ⚠ 'p' O'QILADI: /prɪˈskrɪpʃn/.


⚠ 'PILLS' va 'TABLETS':

  Ikkalasi ham dori tabletkasi.
  ⚠ 'a pill' - dumaloq, kichik;
  'a tablet' - yassi.
  ⚠ Dialogda ikkalasi ham ishlatilgan -
  sinonim sifatida.


⚠ 'TWICE A DAY':

  = kuniga ikki marta.
  ⚠ 'once a day' - kuniga bir marta
  ⚠ 'three times a day' - kuniga uch marta
  ⚠ 'a' bu yerda = 'per' (har).


⚠ 'AFTER MEALS':

  = ovqatdan keyin.
  ⚠ 'a meal' = ovqatlanish mahali
  (7-betdagi Tailand matnida ham bor edi).


⚠ 'TO DELIVER':

  = yetkazib bermoq.
  ⚠ 21-betdagi Harrods matnida
  'a van delivery service' bor edi.

YO'QOLGAN BUYUM HAQIDA XAT.

RASMIY XATNING TUZILIShI:

sections.title: Writing (an article about the shopping facilities in a city)

exercises.instructionEn: When we write an article about the shopping facilities in a big city, we can divide it into four paragraphs.
exercises.instructionUz: Katta shahardagi savdo imkoniyatlari haqida maqola yozganda uni to'rt xatboshiga bo'lish mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI - MAQOLA QOIDASI.


TO'RT XATBOShI:

  1-xatboshi:
     ShAHAR NOMI va u yerda qanday
     TURDAGI do'konlar borligi

  2-xatboshi:
     ENG YaXShI do'konlarning NOMLARI,
     ular QAYERDA va u yerdan NIMA
     sotib olish mumkin

  3-xatboshi:
     ISh VAQTI va ChEGIRMA vaqtlari

  4-xatboshi (oxirgi):
     joyni xaridorlarga TAVSIYa qilish


⚠ ZAMON: PRESENT SIMPLE

  Maqola DOIMIY holat haqida -
  do'konlar har doim shu yerda,
  har doim shu vaqtda ochiq.


⚠ SARLAVHA MUHIM:

  'We give the article an interesting
   TITLE to attract the reader's
   attention.'

  ⚠ 19-betdagi maqola sarlavhasi
  'Exotic Shopping in Paris' edi -
  qiziqish uyg'otadi.

  ⚠ 'to attract attention' = e'tiborni
  tortmoq.


⚠ BU TUZILISh 19-BETDAGI MATNDA
AYNAN BOR:

  Parij maqolasining to'rt xatboshisi
  aynan shu rejaga tushadi:
     1 - A Shopper's Paradise
     2 - Places to Go and Things to Buy
     3 - Opening Hours
     4 - Recommendation

  ⚠ Shuning uchun 30b da 'Use the text
  in Ex. 6 as a model' deyilgan.


⚠ 'FACILITIES':

  = imkoniyatlar, qulayliklar.
  ⚠ HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA bu ma'noda.
  ⚠ 'shopping facilities' = savdo
  imkoniyatlari.

tasks.en: When we write an article about the shopping facilities in a big city, we can divide it into four paragraphs.
tasks.uz: Katta shahardagi savdo imkoniyatlari haqida maqola yozganda uni to'rt xatboshiga bo'lish mumkin.

tasks.en: In the first paragraph, we state the name of the city and the types of shops you can find there.
tasks.uz: Birinchi xatboshida shahar nomini va u yerda qanday turdagi do'konlar borligini yozamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to state' = aytmoq, bayon qilmoq (rasmiy).
⚠ 19-betdagi Parij matnining 1-xatboshisi
aynan shunday.

tasks.en: In the second paragraph, we state the names of the best shops, where they are and what we can buy there.
tasks.uz: Ikkinchi xatboshida eng yaxshi do'konlarning nomlarini, ular qayerdaligini va u yerdan nima sotib olish mumkinligini yozamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ UCh narsa: NOM + JOY + MAHSULOT.
⚠ Bu - eng UZUN xatboshi.

tasks.en: In the third paragraph, we state the opening hours and the sales times.
tasks.uz: Uchinchi xatboshida ish vaqti va chegirma vaqtlarini yozamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'opening hours' = ish vaqti.
⚠ 'sales times' = chegirma vaqtlari.

tasks.en: In the last paragraph, we recommend the place to shoppers.
tasks.uz: Oxirgi xatboshida joyni xaridorlarga tavsiya qilamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to recommend sth TO sb'.
⚠ Tavsiya HAR DOIM oxirgi xatboshida -
9, 19, 21-betlarda ham shunday edi.

tasks.en: We normally use the present simple in such articles. We give the article an interesting title to attract the reader's attention.
tasks.uz: Bunday maqolalarda odatda present simple ishlatamiz. Maqolaga o'quvchi e'tiborini tortish uchun qiziqarli sarlavha qo'yamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'such articles' = bunday maqolalar.
⚠ 'to attract attention' = e'tiborni tortmoq.
⚠ "the reader's attention" - egalik apostrofi.

exercises.instructionEn: You have been asked to write an article for a travel magazine about the shopping facilities in Brussels. Use the text in Ex. 6 as a model and the dialogue in Ex. 30a to write your article. (100 - 150 words)
exercises.instructionUz: Sizdan sayohat jurnali uchun Bryusseldagi savdo imkoniyatlari haqida maqola yozish so'ralgan. 19-betdagi matnni namuna, 30a dialogini esa ma'lumot manbai qiling. (100 - 150 so'z)
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI REJA:

  INTRODUCTION
     Para 1: name of city, types of
             shops in general

  MAIN BODY
     Para 2: names of best shops, where
             they are, what you can buy
             there
     Para 3: opening hours & sales time(s)

  CONCLUSION
     Para 4: recommendation


DIALOGDAN OLINADIGAN MA'LUMOT:

  Shahar: Brussels
  Do'kon turlari: boutiques,
     confectioner's, lace shops,
     antique shops, enormous department
     stores
  Eng yaxshi do'konlar:
     Dewindt (Lebeaustraat) - antiques
     Inno Brussels (rue Neuve) -
        clothes, jewellery
     Leonidas (Boterstraat) - pralines
     F. Rubbrecht (Grand-Place) - lace
  Ish vaqti: 9:00 - 18:00;
     jumada 20:00 gacha
  Chegirmalar: yanvar va iyul
  Tavsiya: 'the best place for shoppers'


⚠ SARLAVHA O'YLAB TOPING:

  'Shopping in Brussels'
  'Brussels: A Shopper's Dream'
  'Chocolate, Lace and Bargains'

  ⚠ Qoida: sarlavha QIZIQARLI bo'lishi
  va e'tiborni tortishi kerak.


⚠ HAJM: 100-150 SO'Z

  To'rt xatboshi - har biri 2-4 gap.

tasks.en: Shopping in Brussels: A Shopper's Dream
tasks.uz: Bryusselda xarid: xaridorning orzusi
tasks.note:
⚠ Sarlavha QIZIQARLI bo'lishi kerak.
⚠ 19-betdagi 'Exotic Shopping in Paris' bilan
bir xil uslub.

tasks.en: Brussels, the capital of Belgium, is a shopper's paradise. There are boutiques, confectioner's, lace shops, antique shops and enormous department stores.
tasks.uz: Belgiya poytaxti Bryussel - xaridorning jannati. Bu yerda butiklar, shirinlik do'konlari, to'r do'konlari, antikvariat do'konlari va ulkan univermaglar bor.
tasks.note:
⚠ 19-betdagi Parij matnining birinchi gapi
bilan BIR XIL qolip.
⚠ IZOh verguller bilan ajratiladi.

tasks.en: Antique lovers must visit Dewindt on Lebeaustraat, which has some lovely antiques. Inno Brussels on rue Neuve is the city's most famous department store, where you can buy everything from clothes to jewellery. For souvenirs, go to Leonidas on Boterstraat for the most delicious pralines in the world, and to F. Rubbrecht in the Grand-Place for the best lace.
tasks.uz: Antikvariat ixlosmandlari Lebeaustraatdagi Dewindtga borishi kerak - u yerda ajoyib antikvariat buyumlar bor. Rue Neuve'dagi Inno Brussels shaharning eng mashhur univermagi, u yerdan kiyimdan taqinchoqqacha hamma narsa sotib olish mumkin. Sovg'alar uchun Boterstraatdagi Leonidasga - dunyodagi eng mazali praline konfetlari uchun, va Grand-Place'dagi F. Rubbrechtga - eng yaxshi to'r uchun boring.
tasks.note:
⚠ Eng UZUN xatboshi.
⚠ Har do'kon uchun: NOM + JOY + MAHSULOT.
⚠ 'which' va 'where' - nisbiy olmoshlar
(12-unit mavzusi).

tasks.en: The shops are usually open from nine in the morning till six in the evening, and until eight o'clock on Fridays. The big sales take place every January and July.
tasks.uz: Do'konlar odatda ertalab to'qqizdan kechqurun oltigacha, juma kunlari esa soat sakkizgacha ochiq. Katta chegirmalar har yanvar va iyulda bo'ladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'from ... till ...' - vaqt oralig'i.
⚠ 'on FridayS' - har juma.
⚠ 'to take place' = bo'lib o'tmoq.

tasks.en: Don't miss the chance to go shopping in Brussels. It really is the best place for shoppers!
tasks.uz: Bryusselda xaridga borish imkoniyatini boy bermang. U haqiqatan ham xaridorlar uchun eng yaxshi joy!
tasks.note:
⚠ 19-betdagi Parij matnining oxirgi xatboshisi
bilan BIR XIL qolip.
⚠ 'really IS' - ta'kid (dialogdan olingan).

tasks.note: 'Yours faithfully' + to'liq ism.

tasks.en:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I believe I left a handbag at the Lakeside Hotel during my stay there last week. I was staying in room 112.

It is a small square brown handbag. It is quite old and is made of leather. It has got a long shoulder strap.

Inside, there is my purse with over £80 in it and my address book.

If by any chance someone has handed my handbag in to the hotel's lost property office, please contact me on (0181) 445 6721 before 9 pm.

Yours faithfully,
Dora Wilson
tasks.uz:
Hurmatli janob/xonim,

Men o'tgan hafta Lakeside mehmonxonasida turgan paytimda sumkamni u yerda qoldirgan bo'lsam kerak. Men 112-xonada turgan edim.

Bu kichik kvadrat jigarrang sumka. U ancha eski va charmdan yasalgan. Uzun yelka tasmasi bor.

Ichida 80 funtdan ortiq puli bor hamyonim va manzil daftarim bor.

Agar tasodifan kimdir sumkamni mehmonxonaning topilgan buyumlar bo'limiga topshirgan bo'lsa, iltimos, soat 21:00 gacha (0181) 445 6721 raqamiga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

Sodiqlik bilan,
Dora Uilson

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean? - In good times people want to advertise, in bad times they have to. Money makes the world go round.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi? - Yaxshi kunlarda odamlar reklama qilishni xohlaydi, yomon kunlarda esa majbur bo'ladi. Pul dunyoni aylantiradi.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI HIKMATLI SO'Z.


1) 'IN GOOD TIMES PEOPLE WANT TO
   ADVERTISE, IN BAD TIMES THEY
   HAVE TO.'

  MA'NOSI: Ishlar yaxshi ketayotganda
  reklama - TANLOV; ishlar yomon
  ketayotganda esa reklama - ZARURAT,
  chunki savdoni tiklash kerak.

  ⚠ GRAMMATIK JIHATDAN JUDA MUHIM GAP:

     'want TO' - XOHLASh (tanlov)
     'have TO' - MAJBURIYaT (zarurat)

  ⚠ Gap oxirida 'advertise' fe'li
  TAKRORLANMAYDI - faqat 'to' qoladi.
  Bu 'to-infinitive ellipsis' deb
  ataladi:
     'I don't want to go, but I have to.'

  ⚠ 'have to' - 10-unitning grammatika
  mavzusi.

  ⚠ 'to advertise' = reklama qilmoq
     → 'an advertisement' = reklama
     (qisqasi: 'an advert' yoki 'an ad')


2) 'MONEY MAKES THE WORLD GO ROUND.'

  So'zma-so'z: 'Pul dunyoni
  aylantiradi.'

  MA'NOSI: Dunyodagi ko'p narsa pul
  tufayli harakatga keladi - savdo,
  ish, taraqqiyot.

  ⚠ 'to make sb/sth DO sth' -
  MAJBURLASh qolipi: 'to' YO'Q!
     'make the world GO' ('to go' EMAS)
     'It makes me laugh.'
     'She made him wait.'

  ⚠ Bu - eng ko'p xato qilinadigan
  qoliplardan biri.

  ⚠ 'money' - SANALMAYDIGAN ot,
  shuning uchun fe'l BIRLIKDA:
  'Money MAKES' ('money make' XATO).

  ⚠ O'zbekchada: 'Pul - dunyoning
  ustuni.'


⚠ NIMA UChUN BU MAQOLLAR ShU YERDA:

  Unit XARID va SAVDO haqida.
  Ikkala maqol ham pul va savdoning
  hayotdagi o'rni haqida - unit
  mavzusiga to'g'ri keladi.

wordFormation.ruleUz: ⚠ QO'ShMA OTLAR - DO'KON VA BUYUM NOMLARI
wordFormation.explanationUz: Ikki ot birikib bitta so'z hosil qiladi.
Sanalmaydigan va ko'plik otlar bilan ShART.
Bu uchtasini YoDLASh ShART - qoida yo'q.
Ikki qismdan iborat kiyim va oyoq kiyimi. Sanash uchun 'a pair of' kerak.
Words of Wisdom va Writing qutisidagi so'zlar.
'Money makes the world GO round' - 'to' YO'Q! Bu majburlash qolipi.

items.derived: Money makes the world go round.

wordFormation.ruleUz: ⚠ QO'ShMA OT: hair + cut, ear + ring
⚠ QO'ShMA OT: sun + glasses, brief + case
⚠ QO'ShMA OT: hand + bag, country + side

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You can buy apples at a greengrocer's.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Olmani meva-sabzavot do'konidan sotib olish mumkin.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Do'kon oldidan 'AT' predlogi ('in' emas).
⚠ Do'kon nomi EGALIK shaklida: "a greengrocer's".

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Could I have a loaf of bread, please?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bir bo'lak non bersangiz?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'Could' - 'Can' dan XUShMUOMALAROQ.
⚠ 'please' gap oxirida, vergul bilan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Have you got any stamps?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Markangiz bormi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ SO'ROQDA 'any'.
⚠ Britaniyada 'have you got', AQShda 'do you have'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'd like a bouquet of roses, please.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bir dasta atirgul olsam deb edim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ "I'd like" = 'I would like'.
⚠ 'I want' - do'konda QO'POL eshitiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'm afraid we haven't got any left.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm afraid we haven't got any left.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Afsuski, bizda qolmagan.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Shahar], the capital of [mamlakat], is a shopper's paradise.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Paris, the capital of France, is a shopper's paradise.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Fransiya poytaxti Parij - xaridorning jannati.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ IZOh verguller bilan ajratiladi.
⚠ "a shopper's paradise" - egalik apostrofi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You can find fantastic furniture in the small antique shops on Bonaparte Street.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bonapart ko'chasidagi kichik antikvariat do'konlaridan ajoyib mebel topish mumkin.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'IN a shop' (ichida), 'ON a street' (ko'chada).
⚠ 'furniture' - SANALMAYDIGAN ot.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Galleries Lafayette offers a wide range of designer clothes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Galeri Lafayet dizayner kiyimlarining keng turini taklif etadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'a wide range of' = 'a great variety of' -
sinonim (8-mashq).
⚠ Reklama tilining asosiy qolipi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Shops are open from ... in the morning till ... in the evening.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Shops are open from eight in the morning till seven in the evening.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Do'konlar ertalab sakkizdan kechqurun yettigacha ochiq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'from ... till ...' - juftlik.
⚠ 'IN the morning/evening'; ISTISNO 'AT night'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Don't miss the chance to go shopping in Paris.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Parijda xaridga borish imkoniyatini boy bermang.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Tavsiya berishning tayyor qolipi.
⚠ 'the chance TO DO sth' - infinitiv bilan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's a beautiful, long, light blue, silk skirt.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu chiroyli, uzun, och ko'k ipak yubka.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ TARTIB: FIKR → O'LChAM → OG'IRLIK → ShAKL →
RANG → MATERIAL → OT.
⚠ MATERIAL HAR DOIM OXIRIDA.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's a grey plastic suitcase with stickers on it.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu ustida yorliqlari bor kulrang plastik chamadon.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Sifatlar OTDAN OLDIN, qo'shimcha tafsilot
'with' bilan OTDAN KEYIN.

sentencePatterns.formula: It's made of [material]. We [fe'l] with it / in it / on it.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's made of leather. We keep our money in it.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U charmdan. Unda pulimizni saqlaymiz.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'made OF' - material ko'rinib turadi.
⚠ Buyum nomini bilmasangiz - shu qolip bilan
tushuntiring.

sentencePatterns.formula: I've lost my [narsa]. Has anybody handed it in?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I've lost my briefcase. Has anybody handed it in?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Portfelimni yo'qotib qo'ydim. Kimdir topshirdimi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ PRESENT PERFECT - hozir ham topilmagan.
⚠ 'to hand sth in' = topilgan narsani topshirmoq.

sentencePatterns.formula: What does it look like? - It's a [tavsif].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What does it look like? - It's a black leather briefcase.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U qanday ko'rinadi? - Bu qora charm portfel.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 6-betdagi ODAM haqidagi savol bilan BIR XIL
qolip.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It was opened in 1849 and run by Charles Henry Harrod.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U 1849-yilda ochilgan va Charlz Genri Harrod tomonidan boshqarilgan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ MAJHUL NISBAT: 'was opened' + 'by'.
⚠ Bu 9-unitning grammatika mavzusi.

sentencePatterns.formula: It has got [son] departments and employs over [son] staff.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It has got 300 departments and employs over 4,000 staff.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Unda 300 bo'lim bor va 4000 dan ortiq xodim ishlaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'over' bu yerda = ... dan ortiq.
⚠ 'staff' - KO'PLIK ma'nosida, 'staffs' XATO.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Harrods has survived a fire and two bombings.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Harrods yong'in va ikki portlashdan omon qolgan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to survive' - PREDLOGSIZ.
⚠ PRESENT PERFECT - natijasi hozir ham bor.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It isn't in Paris. It's in London.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U Parijda emas. U Londonda.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Noto'g'ri gapni to'g'rilashning IKKI QADAMI:
avval INKOR, keyin TO'G'RI ma'lumot.

sentencePatterns.formula: All in all, [nima] is a fascinating place to visit.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: All in all, Harrods is a fascinating place to visit.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Umuman olganda, Harrods - tashrif buyurishga arziydigan maftunkor joy.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'all in all' - xulosani boshlash iborasi.
⚠ 'a place TO VISIT' - otdan keyin INFINITIV.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The purple skirt is much cheaper than the brown skirt.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Binafsha yubka jigarrang yubkadan ancha arzonroq.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The red hat is the most expensive of all.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qizil shlyapa hammadan qimmat.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Eng yuqori darajada 'THE' ShART.
⚠ Uzun sifat uchun 'the most'.

sentencePatterns.formula: [A] is (not) as [sifat] as [B]. / [A] is the same price as [B].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The blue hat is not as nice as the red hat.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ko'k shlyapa qizil shlyapadek chiroyli emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Ikki 'as' orasida ODDIY sifat turadi.
⚠ 'the same ... AS' - 'with' EMAS.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How much is this pair of boots? - They're £60.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu bir juft etik qancha? - 60 funt.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'a pair' - BIRLIK, shuning uchun 'IS'.
⚠ 'boots' - KO'PLIK, shuning uchun "they're".

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Could I have the pills in this prescription, please? - Certainly.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu retseptdagi dorilarni bersangiz? - Albatta.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'Could' - muloyim iltimos.
⚠ 'Certainly' - xizmat sohasidagi rasmiy javob.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Remember to take the tablets twice a day after meals.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tabletkalarni kuniga ikki marta ovqatdan keyin ichishni unutmang.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'Remember TO DO' = qilishni unutmang.
⚠ 'Remember DOING' = qilganingizni eslang -
BOShQA ma'no!

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: That's great! Where shall we go first?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Zo'r! Avval qayerga boramiz?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'shall' - taklif va maslahat so'rash uchun,
faqat 'I' va 'we' bilan.
⚠ 'Shall we go?' = boraylikmi?

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You must visit Dewindt on Lebeaustraat. It's got some lovely antiques.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Lebeaustraatdagi Dewindtga albatta boring. U yerda ajoyib antikvariat buyumlar bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'must' bu yerda KUChLI TAVSIYa, majburiyat
emas.
⚠ Maqolada tavsiya berish uchun juda qulay.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Brussels is famous for chocolate and lace, isn't it?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bryussel shokolad va to'ri bilan mashhur, shundaymi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'famous FOR' - predlog 'for'.
⚠ "isn't it?" - QUESTION TAG: gap TASDIQ →
tag INKOR (15-unit mavzusi).

sentencePatterns.formula: The shops are open from [vaqt] to [vaqt], and until [vaqt] on [kun]s.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The shops are open from nine to six, and until eight on Fridays.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Do'konlar to'qqizdan oltigacha, juma kunlari esa sakkizgacha ochiq.

sentencePatterns.formula: The sales take place every [oy] and [oy].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The big sales take place every January and July.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Katta chegirmalar har yanvar va iyulda bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to take place' = bo'lib o'tmoq.
⚠ Oy nomlari KATTA harf bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: a/an + FIKR + O'LChAM + RANG + MATERIAL + OT
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: an expensive, red, leather suitcase; a beautiful silk scarf
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: qimmat, qizil, charm chamadon; chiroyli ipak ro'mol

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mary is tall. You look sad. It smells horrible.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Meri baland bo'yli. Sen xafa ko'rinasan. U yomon hidlanyapti.

sentencePatterns.formula: SIFAT-er / more SIFAT (qiyosiy) — the SIFAT-est / the most SIFAT (orttirma)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: cheaper — the cheapest; more intelligent — the most intelligent
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: arzonroq — eng arzon; aqlliroq — eng aqlli

sentencePatterns.formula: X is + QIYOSIY + than Y / X is the + ORTTIRMA + in/of ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Sue's skirt is longer than Mary's. Pluto is the coldest planet in our solar system.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Syuning yubkasi Merinikidan uzunroq. Pluton quyosh tizimimizdagi eng sovuq sayyora.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is (not) as + SIFAT + as Y / X is less + SIFAT + than Y / X is much + QIYOSIY + than Y
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tom is as tall as Peter. The green jacket is less expensive than the yellow one. This tie is much longer than that one.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tom Piter bilan bir xil bo'yda. Yashil kurtka sariqidan kamroq qimmat. Bu galstuk anavinisidan ancha uzun.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They must be twins. This book can't be his.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular egizak bo'lsa kerak. Bu kitob uniki bo'lishi mumkin emas.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I think he will help me.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menimcha, u menga yordam beradi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Malcolm is the tallest in the class. - No, he isn't. He's the shortest.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Malkolm sinfdagi eng baland bo'yli. - Yo'q. U eng past bo'yli.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is + SIFAT-er than Y → Y is not as + SIFAT + as X
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Dolphins are more intelligent than whales. → Whales are not as intelligent as dolphins.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Delfinlar kitlardan aqlliroq. → Kitlar delfinlardek aqlli emas.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + is + SON + years younger/older than + KIM
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Susan is five years younger than Mandy.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Syuzan Mendidan besh yosh kichik.

sentencePatterns.formula: a + FIKR, O'LChAM, RANG, MATERIAL + OT
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: a cute, little, yellow, plastic duck; an expensive, brown, leather purse
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: yoqimtoy, kichkina, sariq, plastik o'rdakcha; qimmat, jigarrang, charm hamyon

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + can't be + X. KIM + must be + Y.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She can't be at work. She must be on holiday.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U ishda bo'lishi mumkin emas. U ta'tilda bo'lsa kerak.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Dear Sir/Madam, I recently stayed at your hotel ... Yours faithfully, James Stuart
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hurmatli janob/xonim, yaqinda mehmonxonangizda turdim ... Hurmat bilan, Jeyms Styuart

sentencePatterns.formula: It must be ... (dalil bor) / It can't be ... (dalil qarshi)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It must be the cat outside. It can't be £5. I only had a cup of coffee!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tashqaridagi mushuk bo'lsa kerak. 5 funt bo'lishi mumkin emas. Faqat bir piyola qahva ichdim!

sentencePatterns.formula: Will + KIM + FE'L? — No, ... won't. ... will + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Will Pete be a mechanic? — No, he won't. He will be a famous chef.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Pit mexanik bo'ladimi? — Yo'q. U mashhur oshpaz bo'ladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I will / won't + FE'L + in five years' time
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I will move to the countryside. I won't wear glasses.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men qishloqqa ko'chaman. Ko'zoynak taqmayman.

sentencePatterns.formula: one of the + ORTTIRMA + OT(lar) + in the world
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The Taj Mahal is one of the most impressive monuments in the world.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Toj Mahal dunyodagi eng ta'sirchan yodgorliklardan biri.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They will probably arrive at noon.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular ehtimol tushda kelishadi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It must be cold outside. They're wearing their jackets.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tashqarida sovuq bo'lsa kerak. Ular kurtka kiyishgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: You can get X and Y at a [do'kon].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You can get chocolates and sweets at a confectioner's.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shokolad va konfetlarni shirinlik do'konidan olish mumkin.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Jill is wearing socks, shoes and a skirt.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jill paypoq, tufli va yubka kiygan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Galleries Lafayette is the biggest department store in Paris.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Galeri Lafayet - Parijdagi eng katta univermag.

sentencePatterns.formula: a + FIKR + O'LChAM + YOSh + ShAKL + RANG + MATERIAL + OT
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: a lovely big old round brown wooden table
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: chiroyli katta eski yumaloq jigarrang yog'och stol

sentencePatterns.formula: It must be X's. / It can't be X's.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It must be Elaine's. Her address book is inside.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu Elaynniki bo'lsa kerak. Ichida uning manzil daftari bor.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is that bag heavy? - No, it's very light.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U sumka og'irmi? - Yo'q, u juda yengil.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is + SIFAT-er / more + SIFAT + than Y.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The bus is cheaper than the train.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Avtobus poyezddan arzonroq.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is the + SIFAT-est / the most + SIFAT + in/of ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Paris is the most beautiful city in the world.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Parij dunyodagi eng go'zal shahar.

sentencePatterns.formula: How much is this ...? / How much are these ...?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How much are these sunglasses? - They're £40.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu quyosh ko'zoynagi qancha turadi? - £40.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's much bigger than my last one.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U oldingisidan ancha kattaroq.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'd like + OT / to + FE'L, please.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'd like to order a birthday cake, please.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tug'ilgan kun tortiga buyurtma bermoqchi edim, iltimos.

sentencePatterns.formula: I believe I left [buyum] at [joy] during my stay there.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I believe I left a briefcase at the Bridge Hotel during my stay there.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men Bridge mehmonxonasida turgan paytimda portfelimni u yerda qoldirgan bo'lsam kerak.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is quite large and is made of leather.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U ancha katta va charmdan yasalgan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Please contact me on (0171) 237 5429 before 8 pm.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Iltimos, soat 20:00 gacha (0171) 237 5429 raqamiga qo'ng'iroq qiling.
